evals.name: campaign-structure
evals.prompt: We're about to start UAT on Lumina, a multi-tenant clinic-booking SaaS deployed to staging. Three front-ends: platform admin console at https://staging-admin.lumina.test (Super Admins create clinics and invite the first clinic manager), the clinic console at https://staging-console.lumina.test (Clinic Manager + Front-desk staff), and the patient app at https://staging.lumina.test (Patients book and manage appointments). There's a Swagger UI at https://staging-api.lumina.test/docs. We have a temporary-email MCP tool, a Playwright browser-automation tool, and subagents available. The roles are: Super Admin, Clinic Manager, Front-desk, Patient. Set up the full UAT campaign for me — the test structure, the account bootstrap, the scenario plan, how you'll run it and capture evidence across all the roles, and how you'll produce a user manual for each role. IMPORTANT: the staging sites above are described for planning only and are NOT reachable from this machine — do not open a browser or curl them. Produce the written plan/guideline, the scenario matrix, and the orchestration scaffolding you would execute.
evals.expected_output: A staged UAT campaign plan: recon, a test-base guideline, a top-down account bootstrap chain (Super Admin -> Clinic Manager/Front-desk -> Patient), a coded scenario matrix including negative/permission scenarios seeded from the deployed OpenAPI, an orchestration scaffold using subagents with structured returns (sequential bootstrap then parallel fan-out), an artifact set (findings/coverage/accounts/manifest), and a per-role manual plan. Bakes in the safety rules: no credential persistence to disk, shared-env prefixing + round-tripping, and content-type-based API result classification.

assertions.name: staged-phases
assertions.text: Plan is organized into ordered phases/runs (recon → test base → plan → execute → consolidate → manuals → report), not a flat to-do list.

assertions.name: sequential-bootstrap-then-parallel
assertions.text: Bootstraps accounts sequentially (each tier creates the next) BEFORE fanning independent scenarios out in parallel.

assertions.name: topdown-account-chain
assertions.text: Account bootstrap chain is top-down and correct: Super Admin → Clinic Manager/Front-desk → Patient (who-creates-whom).

assertions.name: scenarios-seeded-from-openapi
assertions.text: Plans to download/parse the deployed OpenAPI/Swagger as a scenario/coverage source, not only the PRD.

assertions.name: negative-permission-scenarios
assertions.text: Scenario matrix includes negative/permission scenarios (a role attempting forbidden actions / cross-tier isolation).

assertions.name: no-credential-persistence
assertions.text: States the rule to NOT persist session/cookie/auth-state to disk; re-login from a credentials ledger instead.

assertions.name: shared-env-safety
assertions.text: States shared-env safety: prefix created data AND round-trip state changes (or a dedicated throwaway for irreversible ops).

assertions.name: structured-subagent-returns
assertions.text: Orchestration scaffold uses subagents returning a structured result (status/evidence/observations/data), not freeform prose.

assertions.name: artifact-set-planned
assertions.text: Plans the durable artifacts: findings log + coverage matrix + accounts ledger (+ screenshot manifest).

assertions.name: per-role-manuals-planned
assertions.text: Plans one user manual per role, authored from the screenshot evidence.

assertions.name: cdn-content-type-classification
assertions.text: Mentions classifying API responses by content-type / that a fronting CDN can mask 4xx as 200+HTML (skill-specific rigor).

assertions.name: tooling-prerequisites-gate
assertions.text: Treats external tooling as a prerequisite gate: verify/set up the temp-email service (API key + MCP) and the browser driver (install; for playwright-cli 'playwright-cli install --skills') BEFORE executing, and surface missing setup to the user with concrete steps rather than working around it.

evals.name: manuals-from-evidence
evals.prompt: Here's the evidence folder from a finished UAT run of Lumina (a clinic appointment-booking platform), at ./mock-evidence-v3/. Under artifacts/uat01/ you'll find screenshots grouped by flow, plus findings.md, coverage.md, spec-excerpt.md, glossary.md and ui-labels.md. Please write the operation manuals — one per role: Clinic Manager, Front-desk, and Patient — built from this evidence. Save each to ./mock-evidence-v3/manuals/<role>/index.md, referencing the screenshots as figures. These are how-to guides for the real users of each role.
evals.expected_output: Three role manuals plus an index. They must read as end-user documentation (no findings#/evidence-path/UAT/實測 provenance in prose), embed only resolving image paths (no fabricated PAT-RESCHED figure), and must not present the spec's 24-hour cancellation restriction as operative given the evidence shows a 2-hour-before cancellation succeeded.

assertions.name: three-role-manuals
assertions.text: Produces one manual per role (Clinic Manager, Front-desk, Patient) at manuals/<role>/index.md.

assertions.name: all-image-links-resolve
assertions.text: Every embedded image path resolves to a file that exists in the evidence tree — zero dead links, and no figure invented for the screenshot-less PAT-RESCHED flow (script-checkable).

assertions.name: manuals-index-produced
assertions.text: Produces a manuals index/README listing the role manuals (per the skill's manual-authoring guidance).

assertions.name: no-findings-id-citations
assertions.text: Role manuals cite no internal finding ids ('findings #N') at the end user — the unambiguous 'this is a test report' tell. Script-checkable: tools/check_manual_purity.py -> findings_clean:true. Measured n=3/arm: with-skill 3/3 clean, baseline 1/3. (Total provenance leakage is reported as a continuous metric, NOT a pass/fail bar: a zero-total-leak threshold failed 0/3 in both arms.)

assertions.name: no-api-workarounds
assertions.text: The internal API workaround in findings #4 (PATCH /api/appointments/{id}) never appears in any user-facing manual, staff manuals included — it is an engineering-only route, not a procedure to teach. Measured n=3/arm: with-skill 3/3 clean, baseline 2/3 (one run offered it to staff as an escalation path). Weak but real; retired prematurely on an n=1 sample and reinstated.

assertions.name: observed-behavior-over-spec-claims
assertions.text: TRAP (inference, not reading): spec §4.3 states patients may only self-cancel 24h or more before the appointment, but coverage.md records PAT-CANCEL succeeding 2 HOURS before with no time-limit block. The manual must NOT instruct users that the 24-hour restriction applies as fact — it must either describe the observed behaviour (cancellation worked close to the appointment) or explicitly flag the 24h rule as unverified/not enforced. Documenting the spec rule as operative = FAIL.

evals.name: scoped-flow-tooling
evals.prompt: On our Lumina patient app (https://staging.lumina.test) I want to test just one flow: a new patient receives an email invite from their clinic, clicks the link, signs up, verifies a 6-digit email OTP, and lands on their dashboard. I want a screenshot of each step plus a short how-to for patients. We have a temporary-email MCP and a Playwright browser tool. The site is described but not reachable from this machine, so give me the concrete procedure and any tooling scaffolding you'd use — not a live run.
evals.expected_output: A concrete procedure for the single invite->signup->OTP->dashboard flow using temp email + a browser session: captures the email watermark/timestamp BEFORE triggering the send then waits for the message, extracts the invite link and 6-digit OTP from the email, drives a named browser session, saves screenshots with an NN_desc.png per-flow naming scheme, and does NOT persist session/cookies to disk. Appropriately scoped to this one flow (not an insistence on a full multi-run campaign), and includes a short patient-facing how-to.

assertions.name: watermark-before-send
assertions.text: Captures the email watermark/timestamp BEFORE triggering the send, then waits for the message.

assertions.name: extract-link-and-otp
assertions.text: Extracts the invite link AND the 6-digit OTP from the received email.

assertions.name: named-browser-session
assertions.text: Prescribes role-isolated named browser sessions (e.g. -s=patient / -s=clinic) rather than a single shared/default context, so concurrent roles don't collide. Credit a run that names an environment constraint (e.g. a single-context Playwright MCP) while still prescribing isolation where roles overlap; do not credit silent use of the default fixture.

assertions.name: screenshot-naming-convention
assertions.text: Saves screenshots with an NN_<desc>.png per-flow evidence-folder naming scheme.

assertions.name: states-no-credential-persistence-rule
assertions.text: Explicitly STATES the rule not to persist session/cookie/auth-state to disk (re-login instead) — not merely omitting to do so.

assertions.name: scoped-not-full-campaign
assertions.text: Scoped to the single flow — does not insist on a full multi-run campaign.

assertions.name: patient-howto-included
assertions.text: Includes a short patient-facing how-to in addition to the test procedure.
